evidence_quotes:
b. (All models except M1123 and “A2”
vehicles). Check all drivebelts tension
using belt tension gauge. Belt tension
should be 70 lbs (311 N) minimum. If
belt tension is not at least 70 lbs (311 N),
adjust drivebelts (paragraph 3-82). Tension
should not be greater than 110 lbs (489 N)
for new belts; old belts 95 lbs (422 N).
statements.reason: The PMCS procedure explicitly excludes M1123 vehicles from the stated drivebelt-tension check and range.
statements.statement: The general PMCS drivebelt-tension range specified in TM 9-2320-280-20-1, Volume 1, does not apply to M1123 vehicles.

statements.reason: The context does not establish that M1123 is a different vehicle model or outside the HMMWV series.
statements.statement: The M1123 is not a standard M998-series HMMWV variant; it is a different vehicle model.

evidence_quotes:
Cracks, glaze, and frays indicate worn belts, which should
be replaced (para.  3-81, all except M1123 and "A2"
vehicles) (para. 3-83, M1123 and "A2" vehicles).
statements.reason: The supplied maintenance text explicitly names M1123 and cites a paragraph for replacing its worn belts.
statements.statement: TM 9-2320-280-20-1 does not cover the M1123 vehicle or include maintenance procedures for that model.
